# Sandbox developer docs

> Sandbox is a tax API stack for India that helps businesses automate compliance across KYC, GST, TDS, Income Tax, and Virtual Accounts.

Remember:
- Docs base: https://developer.sandbox.co.in/

- Environments + versioning rules: see the links below
